summary: Prepare Article 6 projects for authorisation and transaction readiness. Review the five-day course outline and practical learning outcomes.
lede: Article 6 carbon project development training helps project developers, climate-policy officials and environmental advisers prepare mitigation activities and transactions for participation. Participants assess project readiness, map authorisation pathways, organise supporting evidence, and plan safeguards and monitoring responsibilities. Practical exercises use structured worksheets and spreadsheet tracking to consider ITMO transaction readiness and distinguish international transfers from voluntary-market claims.
audienceIntro: Article 6 carbon project development training is intended for professionals who prepare, assess, authorise, finance, or advise on mitigation activities and related market transactions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working familiarity with carbon projects, climate mitigation activities, or carbon markets is recommended. Prior Article 6 transaction experience is not required. Coding or programming is not required. Advanced registry processes, national authorization procedures, and digital MRV system design are introduced at an overview level; exercises focus on project documentation and transaction-readiness decisions.
